text:
leah: quick UX check — banner that appears when a user has no active keys. Current copy: "No API keys yet. Create one to start calling the API." thinking we can make it clearer for new users and improve CTA accessibility.
omar: yeah feels a bit robotic. maybe friendly header + explanatory line. e.g. Title: "No API keys yet" Helper: "Create an API key to authenticate requests from your services." CTA: `Create API key`. keeps it explicit.
maria: +1. Also we should mention permissions required. New users often get confused when the CTA errors. Maybe helper: "You need Owner or Admin permissions to create keys."
tess: UX nit: for screen readers, the CTA should be an actual button with aria-label that includes context, like "Create API key, opens modal". Avoid relying on color alone to convey status.
leah: good point. Also consider empty-state image alt text: "illustration: key on cloud" — concise and descriptive.
omar: another angle: offer a secondary inline action for automation: "Or rotate via API: POST /orgs/:id/keys" — but hide it under a "Advanced" collapsible so novices won't be overwhelmed.
maria: localization: avoid contractions and idioms. Replace "start calling the API" with "start making API requests".
tess: CTA wording tests: "Create API key" vs "Generate credential" vs "Add key". I prefer "Create API key" for clarity.
leah: Modal copy when creating key — need a short confirmation line after success: "API key created. Copy it now — we won't show it again." That phrasing reduces support tickets where users miss the secret.
omar: error handling copy: if creation fails due to quota, say: "Key creation failed: quota exceeded. Request more keys or delete unused keys. Error ID: {{error_id}}". Short and actionable.
maria: for the rotate-confirmation modal (high-risk action) propose a soft confirm: show consequences but not force typed ack unless org > X seats or flagged. For flagged orgs, require typing "ROTATE" to confirm.
tess: accessibility: ensure keyboard focus moves into the modal and focus trap is present. For the success toast, use aria-live="polite" and not assertive.
leah: can we add a microcopy link to docs in the modal footer: "How key rotation works" (opens new tab). Keep link text consistent across settings pages.
omar: tiny copy tweak: replace "revoke" with "remove access" for less technical tone in some contexts, but keep "revoke" in API docs.
designbot: FYI: component id `empty-states/api-keys` in Figma has an outdated copy. Please update if agreed.
leah: next steps: Omar, can you put the final empty-state + modal copy variants into the Figma frame and tag @maria for accessibility review? I'll run a 5-min support sync to confirm the error wording. Thanks. :sparkles:
